# ovirt_network (Data Source)

The ovirt_network data source returns the ID and details of a logical network by its name or ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `datacenter_id` (String) ID of the data center the network belongs to. Used for disambiguation if multiple networks have the same name.
- `id` (String) oVirt ID of the network. Either name or id must be specified.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the logical network. Either name or id must be specified.
